explanation.headline: Ceftriaxone sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; supply at Corvale Lakeside is 8.8 days on hand for the 1 g injection

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows ceftriaxone sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale Lakeside holds 37 vials of the 1 g injection with daily use of 4.2 vials, giving 8.8 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 253 vials of the same 1 g injection with daily use of 12.9 vials, giving 19.6 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 298 vials of the 1 g injection with daily use of 15.8 vials, giving 18.9 days on hand.
The top-ranked option by rule is to transfer 22 vials of 1 g from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside, which would leave Corvale East with 18 days and bring Corvale Lakeside to 14 days.
An alternate manufacturer option from Civica, Inc. cites Hikma Farmacêutica (Portugal) as the plant, but the drug is not on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: All three Corvale sites use product labeled by REMEDYREPACK INC. (NDC 70518249900) whose SPL set identifies the manufacturer as SANDOZ.
rejected.reason: "three" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence
